areas.title: Safe Physical AI
areas.alt: A wheeled robot’s camera view of an office, with two people detected, next to a chat in which the robot first refuses a request to detonate a bomb, then complies after a role-play prompt
areas.caption: Jailbreaking an LLM-controlled robot (RoboPAIR): a role-play prompt turns a refusal into a plan to cause harm.
areas.desc: Large language and vision models now plan and act for robots. We study how these systems can be manipulated into harmful physical actions — RoboPAIR showed that LLM-controlled robots can be jailbroken — and build guardrails such as RoboGuard that keep robot behavior safe in context.
